standard.summary: 每隔多少个 epoch 保存一次 checkpoint。save_every_n_steps 是按步数保存的替代方案。
standard.effect: save_every_n_epochs=1 每 epoch 保存一次。=0 禁用按 epoch 保存，此时 save_every_n_steps 必须大于 0。两者可以同时使用，但不能同时为 0——都为 0 时整个训练只在正常结束时落盘一次，中途崩溃/OOM/手动停止将拿不到任何权重，因此配置校验会直接拒绝这种组合。
standard.whenToUse: 长训练时建议每 1-2 个 epoch 保存一次。配合 checkpoint_keep_last 控制磁盘占用。
standard.avoidWhen: 保存操作有 I/O 开销（大模型可能耗时数秒）。频繁保存在短训练中影响不大。

standard_en.summary: How many epochs apart a checkpoint is saved. save_every_n_steps is the step-based alternative.
standard_en.effect: save_every_n_epochs=1 saves once per epoch. =0 disables epoch-based saving, in which case save_every_n_steps must be greater than 0. Both can be used at once, but they cannot both be 0 -- with both at 0 the whole run only writes to disk when it finishes normally, and a mid-run crash, OOM or manual stop leaves you with no weights at all, so configuration validation rejects that combination outright.
standard_en.whenToUse: Saving every 1-2 epochs is advisable on a long run. Pair it with checkpoint_keep_last to control disk use.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Saving costs I/O (it can take several seconds for a large model). Frequent saving matters little in a short run.

advanced.principle: 在每个 epoch 结束时（或每 N 步时）触发保存。mem_efficient_save 在保存前将 tensor 移到 CPU 以减少 GPU 显存峰值。save_n_epoch_ratio 根据总 epoch 数自动计算保存间隔。
advanced.intervention: training_loop 在 epoch end / step checkpoint 时调用 save_model。
advanced.expectedImpact: 不影响训练质量。确保训练中断时不丢失过多进度。
advanced.tradeoffs: checkpoint_keep_last 限制保留最近 N 个 checkpoint，自动删除旧的。save_model_as 控制保存格式（safetensors/ckpt/pt）。

advanced_en.principle: Triggers a save at the end of each epoch (or every N steps). mem_efficient_save moves tensors to CPU before saving to reduce the GPU VRAM peak. save_n_epoch_ratio computes the save interval automatically from the total epoch count.
advanced_en.intervention: training_loop calls save_model at epoch end / step checkpoints.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Does not affect training quality. Ensures an interruption does not lose too much progress.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: checkpoint_keep_last keeps only the most recent N checkpoints and deletes older ones automatically. save_model_as controls the save format (safetensors/ckpt/pt).
